integrity: All finite counts are independently regenerated by a standalone Python checker; infinite obstructions are proved mathematically, not by enumeration. No independent audit has been performed.
scientific_limitations: Order at most five, cubic nilpotency and vanishing individual squares; transitivity criterion fails at order six. Existence rather than explicit optimal equational basis; relies on published nilpotent finite-duality theorem. Older small-digraph duality literature remains a possible priority overlap.
title: A sharp five-element finite-basis cutoff for cubic-nilpotent semigroups with zero element squares
